categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Tianyuan Dic Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software and information technology services, focusing on application software, technical services, system integration, operation business, and network product sales. Its main industry sectors include telecommunications (providing BOSS systems and digital transformation solutions for major telecom operators), financial IT services (software development, outsourcing, and intelligent operations for banks and insurance companies), government digital solutions (smart policing, digital government platforms), and ICT product distribution (as a major distributor for Huawei, Super Fusion, and DJI).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced IT technologies such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and information security. It develops proprietary software platforms including real-time data lakehouse architectures, AI-enhanced operational platforms, intelligent voice robots, and low-code development platforms. The firm emphasizes AI integration, including large model applications for intelligent data retrieval and analysis, and adapts products for domestic information security standards (Xinchuang).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese telecom operators (China Telecom, China Unicom, China Mobile), large state-owned and joint-stock banks (e.g., Bank of Communications, China Construction Bank, China Bank), insurance companies, government agencies (public security, traffic management), and large enterprises including central and state-owned enterprises. The company serves primarily the telecommunications, financial, government, and ICT distribution markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with subsidiaries and technical support centers in major cities including Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hefei, Wuhan, and others. It also has overseas operations through subsidiaries in Macau and Hong Kong. Its ICT product distribution network covers nationwide China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianyuan Dic operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT supply chain. It develops and sells software products and solutions, provides technical and operational services, and acts as a value-added distributor for ICT hardware products. It is positioned as a solution provider and service operator rather than a hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on enabling digital and intelligent transformation across industries, with significant R&D investment in AI, big data, cloud computing, and information security. Key R&D projects include digital government platforms, AI-powered operational tools, large model technology research, 5G wireless digital technologies, and intelligent voice robots. It emphasizes innovation in AI applications, integration with domestic security standards, and expansion of intelligent operation services to create a second growth curve.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through software product sales, customized software development and services, system integration projects, operation business revenue sharing (e.g., telecom operator cooperation), ICT product distribution sales, and government and enterprise digital solution contracts. The company also earns income from financial outsourcing services and intelligent operation platforms, with some revenue linked to performance-based fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the telecom BOSS system market with over 20 years of experience and a strong foothold in financial IT services and government digital solutions. The telecom IT market is fragmented with many competitors, but Tianyuan Dic leverages its early mover advantage, technical innovation, and comprehensive service capabilities. It competes with other domestic IT service providers and system integrators in banking and telecom sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 6.59 billion RMB, a 15.71% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 28.33 million RMB, a slight decline due to non-recurring items, but adjusted net profit showed growth. The company has total assets exceeding 7 billion RMB and continues to invest heavily in R&D (over 330 million RMB in 2023). It maintains steady growth in revenue with some pressure on profitability due to industry competition and investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianyuan Dic emphasizes its deep industry expertise, especially in telecom and financial sectors, combined with strong R&D capabilities in AI and big data. Its products integrate advanced technologies with domestic security compliance, offering customized, intelligent, and cloud-native solutions. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive service offerings, including intelligent operation outsourcing, and a broad ICT distribution network, enabling clients' digital transformation and operational efficiency improvements.
